0001_initial.sql:
-- 0001 initial schema.
-- Contract: docs/contracts/09-storage.md. Each table has one writing track
-- (S-3) and one data class (S-6, store/schema.py). Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601
-- text ending in Z (D-7). A *_json column is the dump of one Pydantic model (S-2).

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- system --

CREATE TABLE system_state (
    key         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- ------------------------------------------------------------- app: sources

CREATE TABLE sources (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('mail', 'calendar', 'contacts')),
    connector     TEXT NOT NULL,
    label         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    binding_json  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'enabled' CHECK (state IN ('enabled', 'disabled')),
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- attention

CREATE TABLE source_health (
    source_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    state        TEXT NOT NULL
                 CHECK (state IN ('ok', 'stale', 'sign_in_needed', 'unavailable')),
    checked_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    fresh_as_of  TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    handle        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    agent         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    purpose       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('interactive', 'scheduled')),
    started_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_at      TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE events (
    handle        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind          TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject       TEXT,
    dedupe_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (priority BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    summary       TEXT NOT NULL,
    attrs_json    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new'
                  CHECK (state IN ('new', 'delivered', 'handled', 'expired')),
    detected_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivered_at  TEXT,
    delivered_to  TEXT,
    closed_at     TEXT,
    quiet_until   TEXT
) STRICT;

-- At most one live event per condition (A-1).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_live_key ON events (dedupe_key)
    WHERE state IN ('new', 'delivered');
CREATE INDEX events_state_priority ON events (state, priority DESC, detected_at);

CREATE TABLE guidance_deliveries (
    session       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    rule_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    version       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    scope_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivered_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (session, rule_id, scope_key)
) STRICT;

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------- memory

CREATE TABLE cards (
    handle      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL,
    goal        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    position    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    rules       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    state       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open', 'closed')),
    version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version >= 1),
    over_cap    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (over_cap IN (0, 1)),
    review_at   TEXT,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_at   TEXT,
    outcome     TEXT,
    purge_at    TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX cards_state ON cards (state);

CREATE TABLE actions (
    handle        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    card          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title         TEXT NOT NULL,
    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open', 'done', 'dropped')),
    due_at        TEXT,
    snooze_until  TEXT,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_at     TEXT,
    outcome       TEXT,
    purge_at      TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX actions_card ON actions (card, state);
CREATE INDEX actions_due ON actions (state, due_at);

CREATE TABLE card_links (
    card                 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    ref                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    internet_message_id  TEXT,
    created_at           TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (card, ref)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX card_links_message ON card_links (internet_message_id);

CREATE TABLE notes (
    handle      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    action      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES actions (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    text        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX notes_action ON notes (action);

CREATE TABLE evidence (
    handle          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    text            TEXT NOT NULL,
    ref             TEXT,
    subject_sha256  TEXT,
    session         TEXT,
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE evidence_refs (
    evidence    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    owner_kind  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (owner_kind IN ('card', 'action', 'grant', 'operation')),
    owner       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (evidence, owner)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX evidence_refs_owner ON evidence_refs (owner);

CREATE TABLE artifacts (
    handle      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL
                CHECK (kind IN ('mail_body', 'attachment', 'download', 'import', 'text')),
    media_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    size        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0),
    sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64),
    filename    TEXT,
    reason      TEXT NOT NULL,
    state       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live' CHECK (state IN ('live', 'released', 'deleted')),
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    deleted_at  TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX artifacts_sha ON artifacts (sha256);
CREATE INDEX artifacts_state ON artifacts (state, expires_at);

CREATE TABLE artifact_owners (
    artifact    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES artifacts (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    owner_kind  TEXT NOT NULL
                CHECK (owner_kind IN ('action', 'operation', 'grant', 'session', 'run')),
    owner       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (artifact, owner)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX artifact_owners_owner ON artifact_owners (owner);

CREATE TABLE refs (
    handle               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('message', 'calendar_event', 'contact')),
    source_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
    locator              TEXT NOT NULL,
    internet_message_id  TEXT,
    first_seen_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (source_id, kind, locator)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE leases (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    artifact    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES artifacts (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    path        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE cursors (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    session       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tool          TEXT NOT NULL,
    query_sha256  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json  TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at    TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE quarantine (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    original_path     TEXT NOT NULL,
    quarantined_path  TEXT NOT NULL,
    size              INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0),
    found_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    delete_after      TEXT NOT NULL,
    state             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'held' CHECK (state IN ('held', 'deleted'))
) STRICT;

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------- writes

CREATE TABLE grants (
    handle            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('one_off', 'standing')),
    state             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed'
                      CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'active', 'suspended', 'spent',
                                       'revoked', 'expired', 'declined', 'lapsed')),
    source_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
    title             TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    requirement       TEXT NOT NULL
                      CHECK (requirement IN ('none', 'agent_evidence', 'human_confirmation')),
    content_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_sha256) = 64),
    scope_json        TEXT,
    card              TEXT,
    supersedes        TEXT REFERENCES grants (handle),
    proposed_by       TEXT,
    proposed_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    confirmed_via     TEXT CHECK (confirmed_via IN ('agent_evidence', 'human_viewer', 'import')),
    granted_at        TEXT,
    expires_at        TEXT,
    review_at         TEXT,
    last_reviewed_at  TEXT,
    ended_at          TEXT,
    compacted_at      TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX grants_state ON grants (state, source_id);

CREATE TABLE known_recipients (
    source_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    address       TEXT NOT NULL,
    grant         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES grants (handle),
    confirmed_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_id, address)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE operations (
    handle           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    idempotency_key  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind             TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed'
                     CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'authorised', 'prepared', 'dispatched',
                                      'confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'uncertain', 'reconciling',
                                      'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled')),
    grant            TEXT REFERENCES grants (handle),
    card             TEXT,
    session          TEXT,
    intent_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
    intent_json      TEXT,
    reconcile_token  TEXT,
    refs_json        TEXT,
    prepared_json    TEXT,
    receipt_json     TEXT,
    client_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (client_verified IN (0, 1)),
    server_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (server_verified IN (0, 1)),
    error_code       TEXT,
    worker           TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    dispatched_at    TEXT,
    settled_at       TEXT,
    compacted_at     TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX operations_state ON operations (state);
CREATE INDEX operations_grant ON operations (grant, state);
CREATE INDEX operations_source_dispatched ON operations (source_id, dispatched_at);

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    seq             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    at              TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor           TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind            TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject         TEXT,
    summary         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_sha256  TEXT,
    prev_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    hash            TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX audit_log_subject ON audit_log (subject);
0050_runs.sql:
-- Wave 2 track (f): the schedule record, runs, and notes the person leaves for the assistant.
-- Writer: the runs track (src/chamberlain/runs/repo.py). Other tracks only SELECT (S-3).

CREATE TABLE schedules (
    name        TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('mail', 'calendar')),
    at_local    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (at_local GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'),
    weekdays    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(weekdays) BETWEEN 1 AND 13),
    zone        TEXT NOT NULL,
    enabled     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- One row per scheduled pass and local day. A run owns its report artifacts (M-4).
CREATE TABLE runs (
    handle       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    schedule     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedules (name) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    day          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
    state        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'due'
                 CHECK (state IN ('due', 'running', 'finished', 'incomplete', 'missed')),
    due_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at   TEXT,
    finished_at  TEXT,
    session      TEXT,
    UNIQUE (schedule, day)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX runs_state ON runs (state, due_at);

-- A short note from the person in the viewer; it reaches the agent as a `user.note` event.
CREATE TABLE user_notes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    text        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(text) BETWEEN 1 AND 150),
    state       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open', 'withdrawn')),
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX user_notes_state ON user_notes (state, created_at);
0060_mail_watermark.sql:
-- 0060 per-source new-mail watermark and the batch awaiting triage.
-- Writer: the attention track (src/chamberlain/attention/watermark.py). Other tracks only SELECT (S-3).
-- No sender, subject or body is stored here: only identities, times and a suggested card handle.

CREATE TABLE mail_watermarks (
    source_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    covered_through  TEXT NOT NULL,
    watching_since   TEXT NOT NULL,
    scan_started_at  TEXT,
    scan_until       TEXT,
    gap_from         TEXT,
    gap_to           TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE mail_seen (
    seq              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    source_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    locator          TEXT NOT NULL,
    handle           TEXT NOT NULL,
    received_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    first_seen_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    suggested_card   TEXT,
    delivered_event  TEXT,
    triaged          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (triaged IN (0, 1)),
    UNIQUE (source_id, locator)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX mail_seen_pending ON mail_seen (source_id, triaged);
0070_operation_abandoned.sql:
-- 0070 writes track: the `abandoned` state, and what an old journal's operation shows.
-- Contract: docs/contracts/04-writes.md (owner ruling: the owner is not asked to settle what the
-- harness or agent can). `abandoned` ends an uncertain operation that nothing can resend; it frees
-- no grant. `summary_json` is display and matching only (never an intent), `attempted_at` is when
-- the old journal says the write was tried, `redo_at` is when something tried to do it again.
-- The CHECK on `state` cannot be altered, so the table is rebuilt (nothing references it).

CREATE TABLE operations_new (
    handle           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    idempotency_key  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind             TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed'
                     CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'authorised', 'prepared', 'dispatched',
                                      'confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'uncertain', 'reconciling',
                                      'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled', 'abandoned')),
    grant            TEXT REFERENCES grants (handle),
    card             TEXT,
    session          TEXT,
    intent_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
    intent_json      TEXT,
    reconcile_token  TEXT,
    refs_json        TEXT,
    prepared_json    TEXT,
    receipt_json     TEXT,
    client_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (client_verified IN (0, 1)),
    server_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (server_verified IN (0, 1)),
    error_code       TEXT,
    worker           TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    dispatched_at    TEXT,
    settled_at       TEXT,
    compacted_at     TEXT,
    lease_owner      TEXT,
    lease_expires_at TEXT,
    summary_json     TEXT,
    attempted_at     TEXT,
    redo_at          TEXT
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO operations_new (
    handle, idempotency_key, kind, source_id, state, grant, card, session, intent_sha256,
    intent_json, reconcile_token, refs_json, prepared_json, receipt_json, client_verified,
    server_verified, error_code, worker, created_at, updated_at, dispatched_at, settled_at,
    compacted_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at)
SELECT
    handle, idempotency_key, kind, source_id, state, grant, card, session, intent_sha256,
    intent_json, reconcile_token, refs_json, prepared_json, receipt_json, client_verified,
    server_verified, error_code, worker, created_at, updated_at, dispatched_at, settled_at,
    compacted_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at
FROM operations;

DROP TABLE operations;
ALTER TABLE operations_new RENAME TO operations;

CREATE INDEX operations_state ON operations (state);
CREATE INDEX operations_grant ON operations (grant, state);
CREATE INDEX operations_source_dispatched ON operations (source_id, dispatched_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operations_reconcile_token
    ON operations (reconcile_token) WHERE reconcile_token IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON operations
WHEN old.compacted_at IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'operations are deleted only after compaction (W-25)');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_intent_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF intent_sha256 ON operations
WHEN new.intent_sha256 <> old.intent_sha256
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'an operation''s intent hash never changes (W-1)');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_terminal_is_final BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON operations
WHEN old.state IN ('confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled', 'abandoned')
     AND new.state <> old.state
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a terminal operation state is final (W-6)');
END;
0071_known_recipient_origin.sql:
-- 0071 writes track: a recipient can become known from Sent history, not only from a
-- human-confirmed grant. `grant` is now optional and `origin` says how the row arose.
-- Contract: docs/contracts/05-grants.md (G-15), owner decision 2026-11-24.

CREATE TABLE known_recipients_new (
    source_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    address       TEXT NOT NULL,
    grant         TEXT REFERENCES grants (handle),
    origin        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed-grant'
                  CHECK (origin IN ('confirmed-grant', 'sent-history')),
    confirmed_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_id, address),
    CHECK ((origin = 'confirmed-grant') = (grant IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO known_recipients_new (source_id, address, grant, origin, confirmed_at)
    SELECT source_id, lower(address), grant, 'confirmed-grant', confirmed_at
    FROM known_recipients
    GROUP BY source_id, lower(address);

DROP TABLE known_recipients;
ALTER TABLE known_recipients_new RENAME TO known_recipients;
0080_card_context_and_complex.sql:
-- 0080 memory track: (1) a card may hold a stored text item (the context carried over from the
-- old harness), (2) an import ledger for that context, (3) owner-approved larger cards.
-- Contract: docs/contracts/06-memory.md (M-4, M-12, M-28, M-29).

-- (1) `card` becomes an owner kind of artifacts. SQLite cannot change a CHECK, so rebuild.
CREATE TABLE artifact_owners_new (
    artifact    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES artifacts (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    owner_kind  TEXT NOT NULL
                CHECK (owner_kind IN ('action', 'operation', 'grant', 'session', 'run', 'card')),
    owner       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (artifact, owner)
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO artifact_owners_new (artifact, owner_kind, owner, created_at)
    SELECT artifact, owner_kind, owner, created_at FROM artifact_owners;

DROP TABLE artifact_owners;
ALTER TABLE artifact_owners_new RENAME TO artifact_owners;
CREATE INDEX artifact_owners_owner ON artifact_owners (owner);

-- (2) One row per old case whose context has been carried over, so a second import (or an
-- agent that has since forgotten the item) never adds it again.
CREATE TABLE imported_context (
    case_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    card         TEXT NOT NULL,
    artifact     TEXT NOT NULL,
    imported_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- (3) One row per card that asked for, or holds, a larger cap. Only the owner (the viewer)
-- moves a row out of `pending`. A revoked card has no row. `blocked_until` is set on a decline.
CREATE TABLE complex_cards (
    card           TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES cards (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    state          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'approved', 'declined')),
    reason         TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    decided_at     TEXT,
    blocked_until  TEXT,
    CHECK ((state = 'pending') = (decided_at IS NULL))
) STRICT;
0110_uncertain_send_recheck.sql:
-- 0110 uncertain-send track: the `superseded` state, the 24-hour re-check of an uncertain send,
-- and the link from a resend to the send it replaces.
-- Contract: docs/contracts/04-writes.md (W-37 to W-41).
-- `superseded` ends an uncertain send that the agent sent again after the harness's one re-check
-- found it missing. Its grant use passes to the resend (so `superseded` releases it).
-- `rechecked_at` / `recheck_result` (`found`, `queued`, `missing`) hold the re-check; `recheck_json`
-- holds where it looked. `redo_of` names the send a resend replaces; one live resend per original.
-- The CHECK on `state` cannot be altered, so the table is rebuilt (nothing references it).

CREATE TABLE operations_new (
    handle           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    idempotency_key  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind             TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed'
                     CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'authorised', 'prepared', 'dispatched',
                                      'confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'uncertain', 'reconciling',
                                      'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled', 'abandoned',
                                      'superseded')),
    grant            TEXT REFERENCES grants (handle),
    card             TEXT,
    session          TEXT,
    intent_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
    intent_json      TEXT,
    reconcile_token  TEXT,
    refs_json        TEXT,
    prepared_json    TEXT,
    receipt_json     TEXT,
    client_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (client_verified IN (0, 1)),
    server_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (server_verified IN (0, 1)),
    error_code       TEXT,
    worker           TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    dispatched_at    TEXT,
    settled_at       TEXT,
    compacted_at     TEXT,
    lease_owner      TEXT,
    lease_expires_at TEXT,
    summary_json     TEXT,
    attempted_at     TEXT,
    redo_at          TEXT,
    rechecked_at     TEXT,
    recheck_result   TEXT CHECK (recheck_result IN ('found', 'queued', 'missing')),
    recheck_json     TEXT,
    redo_of          TEXT
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO operations_new (
    handle, idempotency_key, kind, source_id, state, grant, card, session, intent_sha256,
    intent_json, reconcile_token, refs_json, prepared_json, receipt_json, client_verified,
    server_verified, error_code, worker, created_at, updated_at, dispatched_at, settled_at,
    compacted_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, summary_json, attempted_at, redo_at)
SELECT
    handle, idempotency_key, kind, source_id, state, grant, card, session, intent_sha256,
    intent_json, reconcile_token, refs_json, prepared_json, receipt_json, client_verified,
    server_verified, error_code, worker, created_at, updated_at, dispatched_at, settled_at,
    compacted_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, summary_json, attempted_at, redo_at
FROM operations;

DROP TABLE operations;
ALTER TABLE operations_new RENAME TO operations;

CREATE INDEX operations_state ON operations (state);
CREATE INDEX operations_grant ON operations (grant, state);
CREATE INDEX operations_source_dispatched ON operations (source_id, dispatched_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operations_reconcile_token
    ON operations (reconcile_token) WHERE reconcile_token IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON operations
WHEN old.compacted_at IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'operations are deleted only after compaction (W-25)');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_intent_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF intent_sha256 ON operations
WHEN new.intent_sha256 <> old.intent_sha256
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'an operation''s intent hash never changes (W-1)');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_terminal_is_final BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON operations
WHEN old.state IN ('confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled', 'abandoned', 'superseded')
     AND new.state <> old.state
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a terminal operation state is final (W-6)');
END;

-- One live resend per original (a cancelled proposal does not count).
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operations_redo_of
    ON operations (redo_of) WHERE redo_of IS NOT NULL AND state <> 'cancelled';
0130_report_dashboard.sql:
-- 0130 report and dashboard (track d-dashboard).
-- Contract: docs/contracts/06-memory.md (lifetimes) and 09-storage.md (tables).
-- (1) run_reports: what the harness itself wrote into a pass's report, taken when the pass
--     settled (the agent's text stays a stored item and is read from there). Writer: runs.
-- (2) local_events: events the owner adds in the viewer. They exist nowhere else. Writer: runs.
-- (3) event_labels: the category (and short title) the agent gave a calendar event. Writer: memory.

CREATE TABLE run_reports (
    run          TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs (handle) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    composed_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    report_json  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE local_events (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 180),
    location    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(location) <= 600),
    all_day     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (all_day IN (0, 1)),
    start_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_day   TEXT NOT NULL,
    end_day     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX local_events_days ON local_events (end_day, start_day);

CREATE TABLE event_labels (
    identity     TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(identity) = 64),
    category     TEXT NOT NULL
                 CHECK (category IN ('work', 'personal', 'social', 'travel', 'health',
                                     'occasion', 'home')),
    title        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(title) <= 120),
    last_day     TEXT NOT NULL,
    labelled_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX event_labels_day ON event_labels (last_day);
0150_mail_folder_sync.sql:
-- 0150 mail folder sync: before the scan reads a source, the harness asks the mail client to sync
-- every folder the scan reads, waits, and records when each folder was last in sync.
-- Writer: the attention track (src/chamberlain/attention/sync.py). Contract: 07-attention.md A-24 to A-27.
-- Folder names are kept so a report can name the folders that would not sync; no mail is stored here.

CREATE TABLE mail_sync (
    source_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    complete_at   TEXT,
    attempted_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE mail_sync_folders (
    source_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    folder_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    name          TEXT NOT NULL,
    role          TEXT NOT NULL,
    synced_at     TEXT,
    attempted_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    failure       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    catchup_from  TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_id, folder_id)
) STRICT;

-- How long before a scheduled pass the tick starts the sync (0 turns it off), per schedule.
ALTER TABLE schedules ADD COLUMN presync_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5
    CHECK (presync_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 120);
0190_review.sql:
-- 0190 harness review: what the agent improvises, and the reviews of it.
-- Writer: the review track (src/chamberlain/review/repo.py). Others only SELECT (S-3).
-- Privacy: only tool names and short normalised command summaries live here, never output, mail
-- text or file contents (docs/contracts/06-memory.md, M-40).

-- One row per pattern: a tool the agent used that is not a Chamberlain tool, with a short summary
-- of the command ('' when only the tool name is recorded).
CREATE TABLE improv_patterns (
    agent         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (agent IN ('claude', 'codex')),
    tool          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(tool) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
    pattern       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(pattern) <= 60),
    total         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total >= 1),
    first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    added_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (agent, tool, pattern)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX improv_patterns_seen ON improv_patterns (last_seen_at);

-- Where each transcript file was read up to, so a scan never counts a line twice. The key is a
-- hash of the file's path: no path, project name or session id is kept.
CREATE TABLE improv_files (
    file_key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(file_key) = 64),
    byte_pos   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_pos >= 0),
    size       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0),
    qualified  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (qualified IN (0, 1)),
    seen_at    TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- One review round: raised when the interval has passed and the log has new patterns.
CREATE TABLE review_rounds (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    state       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (state IN ('open', 'done', 'lapsed')),
    opened_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    closed_at   TEXT,
    new_patterns INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (new_patterns >= 0)
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX review_rounds_state ON review_rounds (state, opened_at);

-- What the agent found in a round (`keep` kind `finding`). Only a worrying one reaches the owner.
CREATE TABLE review_findings (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    round       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('idea', 'worrying')),
    text        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(text) BETWEEN 1 AND 400),
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    reported_at TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX review_findings_round ON review_findings (round);
0200_imported_items.sql:
-- 0200 one row per old record the importer has carried into v2 (card rules, important flags,
-- owner instruction topics, proposed read-state grants), so a second import adds only what is
-- missing and never brings back what the owner or the agent has since changed or removed.
CREATE TABLE imported_items (
    kind         TEXT NOT NULL,
    old_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    target       TEXT NOT NULL,
    imported_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (kind, old_id)
) STRICT;
0220_imported_uncertain_closed.sql:
-- 0220 u-settle: a write left unfinished in an old harness's journal is closed, not reviewed.
-- The old harness owns its own journals (both run side by side), and the owner is never asked to
-- settle them. Imported operations hold no stored request, so nothing could ever resend one.
-- They become `abandoned` (terminal, frees nothing) with a receipt, so they drop out of every
-- list of work. The harness's audit chain is not extended here (SQL cannot sign a row); the
-- import report and this note are the record. Open `operation.uncertain` events for them close
-- on the next tick, because the detector no longer reports them.
UPDATE operations
SET state = 'abandoned',
    settled_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'),
    updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'),
    lease_owner = NULL,
    lease_expires_at = NULL,
    receipt_json = json_object(
        'summary', json_object(
            'intent_kind', kind,
            'source', source_id,
            'state', 'abandoned',
            'intent_sha256', intent_sha256,
            'settled_at', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'),
            'verification', json_object('client_verified', json('false'), 'server_verified', json('false')),
            'items_ok', 0,
            'items_failed', 0),
        'items', json('[]'),
        'warnings', json('[]'))
WHERE state IN ('uncertain', 'reconciling')
  AND intent_json IS NULL
  AND idempotency_key LIKE 'import:%';
0230_outside_actions.sql:
-- 0230 o-outside: the `agent_reported` operation state, for an outside action the assistant says
-- it did (docs/contracts/04-writes.md W-44 to W-47).
-- The CHECK on `state` cannot be altered, so the table is rebuilt exactly as it stands, with the new
-- state added to the CHECK and to the "terminal is final" trigger. Nothing references it.
-- Several sources in one standing grant (05-grants.md G-26) needs no change here: a scope's new
-- `sources` field is left out of every existing scope, so existing grants keep their stored scope,
-- their content hash and their meaning. Grants are found by `json_each` over the stored scope.

CREATE TABLE operations_new (
    handle           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    idempotency_key  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind             TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed'
                     CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'authorised', 'prepared', 'dispatched',
                                      'confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'uncertain', 'reconciling',
                                      'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled', 'abandoned',
                                      'superseded', 'agent_reported')),
    grant            TEXT REFERENCES grants (handle),
    card             TEXT,
    session          TEXT,
    intent_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
    intent_json      TEXT,
    reconcile_token  TEXT,
    refs_json        TEXT,
    prepared_json    TEXT,
    receipt_json     TEXT,
    client_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (client_verified IN (0, 1)),
    server_verified  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (server_verified IN (0, 1)),
    error_code       TEXT,
    worker           TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    dispatched_at    TEXT,
    settled_at       TEXT,
    compacted_at     TEXT,
    lease_owner      TEXT,
    lease_expires_at TEXT,
    summary_json     TEXT,
    attempted_at     TEXT,
    redo_at          TEXT,
    rechecked_at     TEXT,
    recheck_result   TEXT CHECK (recheck_result IN ('found', 'queued', 'missing')),
    recheck_json     TEXT,
    redo_of          TEXT
) STRICT;

INSERT INTO operations_new (
    handle, idempotency_key, kind, source_id, state, grant, card, session, intent_sha256,
    intent_json, reconcile_token, refs_json, prepared_json, receipt_json, client_verified,
    server_verified, error_code, worker, created_at, updated_at, dispatched_at, settled_at,
    compacted_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, summary_json, attempted_at, redo_at,
    rechecked_at, recheck_result, recheck_json, redo_of)
SELECT
    handle, idempotency_key, kind, source_id, state, grant, card, session, intent_sha256,
    intent_json, reconcile_token, refs_json, prepared_json, receipt_json, client_verified,
    server_verified, error_code, worker, created_at, updated_at, dispatched_at, settled_at,
    compacted_at, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, summary_json, attempted_at, redo_at,
    rechecked_at, recheck_result, recheck_json, redo_of
FROM operations;

DROP TABLE operations;
ALTER TABLE operations_new RENAME TO operations;

CREATE INDEX operations_state ON operations (state);
CREATE INDEX operations_grant ON operations (grant, state);
CREATE INDEX operations_source_dispatched ON operations (source_id, dispatched_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operations_reconcile_token
    ON operations (reconcile_token) WHERE reconcile_token IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operations_redo_of
    ON operations (redo_of) WHERE redo_of IS NOT NULL AND state <> 'cancelled';

CREATE TRIGGER operations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON operations
WHEN old.compacted_at IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'operations are deleted only after compaction (W-25)');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_intent_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF intent_sha256 ON operations
WHEN new.intent_sha256 <> old.intent_sha256
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'an operation''s intent hash never changes (W-1)');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER operations_terminal_is_final BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON operations
WHEN old.state IN ('confirmed', 'failed_clean', 'confirmed_absent', 'cancelled', 'abandoned',
                   'superseded', 'agent_reported')
     AND new.state <> old.state
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a terminal operation state is final (W-6)');
END;

0260_calendar_prepared.sql:
-- Convert active calendar plans once, in the same transaction as the migration ledger.
-- A nonterminal plan is needed for recovery: never fabricate an identity or retry a write.
-- Refuse unknown/malformed plans so the pre-migration backup remains recoverable.
CREATE TEMP TABLE calendar_plan_guard (ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok = 1)) STRICT;

INSERT INTO calendar_plan_guard (ok)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM operations AS o
    LEFT JOIN sources AS s ON s.id = o.source_id
    WHERE o.kind IN ('calendar.create', 'calendar.update', 'calendar.delete', 'calendar.respond')
      AND o.state IN ('proposed', 'authorised', 'prepared', 'dispatched', 'uncertain', 'reconciling')
      AND o.prepared_json IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(s.connector, '') != 'demo'
      AND CASE WHEN json_valid(o.prepared_json) IS NOT 1 THEN 1
          WHEN json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data') IS NOT 'object' THEN 1
          WHEN json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.source') IS NOT o.source_id THEN 1
          WHEN json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.intent_kind') IS NOT o.kind THEN 1
          WHEN json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.payload') = 'object' THEN 0
          WHEN json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.payload') IS NOT NULL THEN 1
          WHEN COALESCE(s.connector, '') NOT IN ('thunderbird', 'caldav', 'google_calendar') THEN 1
          WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.create' AND
               (json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.reconcile_token') IS NOT 'text' OR
                length(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.reconcile_token')) = 0 OR
                (o.reconcile_token IS NOT NULL AND
                 json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.reconcile_token') IS NOT o.reconcile_token) OR
                json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.fields') IS NOT 'object') THEN 1
          WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.update' AND json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.fields') IS NOT 'object' THEN 1
          WHEN o.kind != 'calendar.create' AND
               (json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.expected_etag') IS NOT 'text' OR
                length(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.expected_etag')) = 0) THEN 1
          WHEN s.connector = 'thunderbird' THEN CASE
              WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.respond' THEN 1
              WHEN json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.event_id') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              WHEN length(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.event_id')) = 0 THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind IN ('calendar.create', 'calendar.update') AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.icalendar') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind IN ('calendar.update', 'calendar.delete') AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.expected_icalendar') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END
          WHEN s.connector = 'caldav' THEN CASE
              WHEN json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.name') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              WHEN length(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.name')) = 0 THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind IN ('calendar.create', 'calendar.update', 'calendar.respond') AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.ics') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.delete' AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.occurrence') = 'text' AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.ics') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.respond' AND
                   (json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.response') IS NOT 'text' OR
                    json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.address') IS NOT 'text') THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END
          WHEN s.connector = 'google_calendar' THEN CASE
              WHEN o.kind != 'calendar.create' AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.locator') IS NOT 'text' THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind != 'calendar.create' AND
                   length(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.locator')) = 0 THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind IN ('calendar.create', 'calendar.update') AND
                   json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.body') IS NOT 'object' THEN 1
              WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.respond' AND
                   (json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.response') IS NOT 'text' OR
                    json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.attendees') IS NOT 'array') THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END
          ELSE 1 END = 1
) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END;

DROP TABLE calendar_plan_guard;

UPDATE operations AS o
SET prepared_json = json_set(
    o.prepared_json,
    '$.data', json_object(
        'payload', json(CASE s.connector
            WHEN 'thunderbird' THEN json_set(
                json_remove(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data'), '$.fields', '$.expected_etag'),
                '$.kind', substr(o.kind, 10)
            )
            WHEN 'google_calendar' THEN CASE WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.respond' THEN json_set(
                json_remove(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data'),
                    '$.fields', '$.expected_etag', '$.locator', '$.attendees'),
                '$.body', json_object('attendees', json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.attendees')),
                '$.notify', json('true')
            ) ELSE json_remove(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data'),
                '$.fields', '$.expected_etag', '$.locator') END
            ELSE json_remove(json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data'), '$.fields', '$.expected_etag')
        END),
        'locator', CASE WHEN o.kind = 'calendar.create' THEN NULL
            WHEN s.connector = 'thunderbird' THEN json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.event_id')
            WHEN s.connector = 'google_calendar' THEN json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.locator')
            WHEN json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.occurrence') = 'text' THEN
                json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.name') || '#' ||
                json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.occurrence')
            ELSE json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.name') END,
        'expected_etag', json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.expected_etag'),
        'fields', json_extract(o.prepared_json, '$.data.fields')
    )
)
FROM sources AS s
WHERE s.id = o.source_id
  AND s.connector IN ('thunderbird', 'caldav', 'google_calendar')
  AND o.kind IN ('calendar.create', 'calendar.update', 'calendar.delete', 'calendar.respond')
  AND o.state IN ('proposed', 'authorised', 'prepared', 'dispatched', 'uncertain', 'reconciling')
  AND o.prepared_json IS NOT NULL
  AND json_type(o.prepared_json, '$.data.payload') IS NULL;
